$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

font/display.description: PROVISIONAL (JKIDD.md decision 1, option a). Card statements and headlines.

font/body.description: Inter, for running text (User, 2026-10-11). Was Architects Daughter.

font/lettering.description: Comic lettering for short text: tabs, labels. Code reads CC Wild Words, then Anime Ace 2.0 BB, both loaded from the machine and never bundled; Figma holds Comic Neue (OFL), the stand-in the code falls back to where neither is installed.

font/burst.description: Loud titles: the link page wordmark, row titles and tiles. Bangers (OFL).

Card/Statement.description: Manifesto statement on the 1600px canvas: 120px, the floor of the spec's 120–160 range, so 3 lines fit the content zone. Break lines by meaning.

Card/Title.description: Zone and stage titles on cards.

Card/Body.description: Ledger rows and supporting lines on cards.

Card/Code.description: Token names, commands, props on cards.

Card/Chrome.description: Frame chrome: day stamp, handle, series mark. Never changes.

Card/Kicker.description: Post type label above a statement.

Link/Wordmark.description: Header wordmark on the link page. .lk-header__wordmark; 26px below 640px (Link/Wordmark Compact).

Link/Body.description: Bio and row descriptions, scrim at 60%. .lk-profile__bio, .lk-row__desc.

Link/Kicker.description: Category label above a row or tile title. .lk-kicker__label.

Link/Nav.description: Header links and the Follow button. .lk-header__link, .lk-follow.

Elevation/Card.description: Lift for cards presented on a documentation canvas. Not used inside a card.

Elevation/Thumbnail.description: Feed-size lift for the 320px thumbnail test.

Imagery/Stock/Palm Sky 16:9 (master).description: The palm sky: a palm against a teal sky, 16:9, 1920×1080, the master as JPEG. Master: packages/ui/vendor/stock/palm-sky.source.png; pnpm stock crops it to every shape in packages/ui/src/imagery/stock (16:9, 3:2, 2:3, 1:1, 4:5), at full height, held right so the palm stays. The link page backdrop (cover, centred, over primary-container) and the dark stock for 16:9 dressed backs, under a 75% wash of the dark scheme's surface. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/palm-sky-16x9.jpg.

Imagery/Stock/Palm Sky 3:2.description: The palm sky cropped to 3:2, 1620×1080: full height, held right so the palm stays. 3:2 dressed backs. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/palm-sky-3x2.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Palm Sky 1:1.description: The palm sky cropped to 1:1, 1080×1080: full height, held right so the palm stays. 1:1 dressed backs. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/palm-sky-1x1.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Palm Sky 4:5.description: The palm sky cropped to 4:5, 864×1080: full height, held right so the palm stays. 4:5 dressed backs. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/palm-sky-4x5.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Palm Sky 2:3.description: The palm sky cropped to 2:3, 720×1080: full height, held right so the palm stays. The link page backdrop on phones. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/palm-sky-2x3.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Paper 16:9.description: The card stock cut to 16:9, 2428×1366: nine-sliced from the 3:2 master so the burnt edge stays even. 16:9 backs and card anatomy. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/paper-16x9.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Paper 3:2 (master).description: The card stock: a warm parchment sheet, 3:2, 2048×1366, always stretched to its frame, never cropped, so the burnt edges show. Master: packages/ui/vendor/stock/paper.source.jpg; pnpm stock cuts it to every shape in packages/ui/src/imagery/stock (3:2, 2:3 turned 90°, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5). Under the link page sheet, every dressed postcard back and the stage postcards; whatever prints on it takes the Light scheme. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/paper-3x2.jpg.

Imagery/Stock/Paper 1:1.description: The card stock cut to 1:1, 1366×1366: nine-sliced from the 3:2 master. 1:1 backs. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/paper-1x1.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Paper 4:5.description: The card stock cut to 4:5, 1366×1708: nine-sliced from the 2:3 cut. 4:5 backs. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/paper-4x5.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Stock/Paper 2:3.description: The card stock turned 90°, 2:3, 1366×2048. The link page sheet. packages/ui/src/imagery/stock/paper-2x3.jpg (pnpm stock).

Imagery/Portrait.description: Jefferson Kidd portrait, 344×344, for the profile avatar (172px at 2×). packages/ui/src/imagery/jeffersonkidd-portrait.jpg.

Imagery/Texture/Fibres.description: The card stock's fibres: fine fractal grain and long paper fibres in on-surface at 8%, a 640px tile. Stack over a stock fill. Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-texture=fiber], the floor texture.

Imagery/Texture/Laid Paper.description: Laid paper: chain lines every 104px at 9% and laid lines every 6px at 6%, in on-surface, tiled. Stack over a stock fill. Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-texture=laid].

Imagery/Texture/Halftone Screen.description: Halftone: a 14px dot screen in on-surface at 20%, fading in from 38% across to the right edge; one card's worth, stretched to the frame. Stack over a stock fill. Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-texture=halftone].

Imagery/Overlay/Western Press.description: The western press: the western master's grain, a 512px tile, overlay blend at 45%. The topmost fill, over the content too. Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-overlays~=press] and picturepostcard.css .jk-pic__grain. packages/ui/src/imagery/press/grain.png.

Imagery/Overlay/Specks.description: The press's dropout: the paper showing through the ink, white specks on a 512px tile, stacked over the Western Press. In code they mask the series' cream (picturepostcard.css .jk-pic__dropout), at the front's press. packages/ui/src/imagery/press/specks.png.

Imagery/Overlay/Foxing.description: Foxing: five soft age spots in tertiary at 55%, multiplied at 16%, at seed 7's places on a 1600×900 card. The topmost fill. In code each card's seed places them. Code: dressedpostcard.css [data-overlays~=foxing].

611:128.name: Emblem
611:128.description: The winged seahorse: J.F. Kidd's logo, favicon and avatar, drawn from the master's own geometry (Illustrations › Logo Assets › asset 3; code: Emblem in @jkidd/ui, EMBLEM in @jkidd/core). Badge is the whole emblem in its ring; Figure is the seahorse alone, boxed tight. Original is the master's black, grey and white (neutral 0, 70, 100) and holds on light or dark because the badge brings its own field. Mono is one ink (Scheme on-surface), with the halo's outline knocked out of the body and ring, for one-colour print and stamps. Resize an instance to scale it.
